title: New app icon
summary: GI Helper has a new icon, a scanner frame around a gem, used everywhere: browser tab, top bar, share image and home screen.

changes.text: New icon: teal scanner brackets framing a glowing gem. The browser tab, top bar and share image all use it.
Proper icons when you add GI Helper to your home screen on iPhone, iPad and Android.
Installing the app now shows the name GI Helper and the current description, instead of an old name.
